in_marathi.name: Gudakesha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who subdues desires
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gudakesha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Gudakesha' is derived from Sanskrit words 'guda' meaning 'desire' and 'kesh' meaning 'hair or head'. This name signifies a person who has the strength and determination to subdue their desires and impulses. In Hindu mythology, the deity Lord Ganesha, who is also known as 'Gudakesha', is revered for his ability to control his senses and desires.
